study: European model-contract accounting replay on historical stock prices
price_basis: FMP split-adjusted close; dividends excluded; not a total-return index
rate_interpretation: constant illustrative model financing rate, not a historical rate observation
stock_execution: observe close and transact at same model close plus assumed proportional cost
limitations: No historical option quotes or historical implied volatilities
No listed-option executable backtest or American exercise claim
No dividends, split event processing, margin, borrow fees or option spreads
Source observation index used as session calendar; exchange calendar not independently verified
Three current survivors and two illustrative historical windows are not an unbiased sector study

normal_2019/short_calls_stock_hedged.model: European fixed-volatility model contracts on supplied underlying observations
normal_2019/short_calls_stock_hedged.data_label: FMP split-adjusted historical stock closes; synthetic model option contracts
normal_2019/short_calls_stock_hedged.time_convention: one trading session per supplied row; rates/volatilities annualized
normal_2019/short_calls_stock_hedged.capital_convention: gross long core-equity inception value unless initial_capital is supplied
limitations: No historical option quotes or executable listed-option claim
No American exercise/assignment
No dividends or corporate-action processing
No option spreads, margin, stock borrow charges or asymmetric funding
Fixed volatility inputs require separate availability/cutoff verification

volatility_calibration.method: sample standard deviation of prior daily log returns times sqrt(252)
volatility_calibration.interpretation: realized-volatility proxy supplied as fixed model sigma; not historical implied volatility
